tests.name: Product Rejection with Feedback Persistence

tests.actual: Status=REJECTED, Reason="المواصفات الفنية غير مكتملة، يرجى توضيح كود التتبع ومعيار التبريد"

tests.name: Public Catalog Selective Exposure
tests.expected: Approved product is visible, Rejected product is strictly excluded

tests.name: Product Details Retrieval
tests.operation: Fetch full product details and specifications
tests.expected: Full specifications, manufacturer name and packaging returned
tests.actual: Product name="تمر مجدول فاخر درجة أولى - معدل للاختبار", Manufacturer="شركة ثمار النيل للتصدير والاستثمار الزراعي"

tests.name: RFQ / Order Inquiry Persistence
tests.operation: Submit RFQ form from product details page
tests.expected: RFQ record saved with buyer details, product ID, and quantity in PostgreSQL
tests.actual: Table exists: false, Backend route exists: false. Frontend uses client-side DOM mockup (handleRfqSubmit / handleFormSubmit) without API transmission.
tests.notes: Critical Finding: RFQ and Contact forms currently only toggle UI visibility classes and do not submit to any backend API or persist to PostgreSQL.

tests.name: Smart Fuzzy Matching Engine
tests.operation: Query fuzzy matcher with "محطة البستان للتعبئة"

tests.actual: Matched: "محطة البستان للحاصلات الزراعية والتصدير", Code=EGY-BUS-01, Model=DIRECT_CONTRACT, Confidence=0.65%
